nodes.label: URL Reported User Constraint Contradiction
nodes.rationale: The DDL makes url_reported.user_id both NOT NULL and ON DELETE SET NULL, requiring a product decision before choosing either nullable audit retention or cascade deletion.

nodes.label: URL Flag URL Index Candidate
nodes.rationale: url_flag.url is queried for every prediction but must be validated with production-representative EXPLAIN ANALYZE data before adding an index.

nodes.label: Alembic Adoption Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Versioned migrations are recommended before non-additive schema changes because init.sql runs only for newly initialized container data directories.

nodes.label: Transaction Atomicity Gap
nodes.rationale: Service methods commit independently, allowing a report update to succeed while its subsequent audit-history commit fails.

nodes.label: Retraining Pipeline Gap
nodes.rationale: Prediction queueing, manual dataset file selection, and training submission are disconnected and require product decisions about dataset representation and eligibility.

nodes.label: Cross Cutting Audit Logging Gap
nodes.rationale: Only URL report history covers a required audit category; a shared audit table and helper are needed to cover role, key, model, flag, service, and training mutations.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy Column Typing Gap
nodes.rationale: Legacy SQLAlchemy Column declarations cause most mypy errors even though ORM instance attributes behave as plain Python values at runtime.
